rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for wealth or riches.

example.english: After years of hard work, they finally amassed considerable opulence.
example.traditional: 佢哋捱咗好多年，終於累積咗可觀嘅財富。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ngaai4 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 leoi6 zik1 zo2 ho2 gun1 ge3 coi4 fu3

rows.note: Use this when the opulence means a conspicuous show of wealth, pomp, or luxury.

example.english: The opulence of this wedding banquet is absurd.
example.traditional: 今次婚宴擺咁大排場，真係有錢到離譜。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 fan1 jin3 baai2 gam3 daai6 paai4 coeng2 zan1 hai6 jau5 cin2 dou3 lei4 pou2
